purpose: Qualify new full-model budgets using upstream outputs only; existing component gates and arithmetic remain unchanged
relative_rms_definition: Per token row: L2(actual - expected) / L2(expected), flattening head dimensions; zero signal requires exact equality
calibration_rule: For each of 75 boundaries, round up margin times the largest required atol and relative RMS to their respective quanta, respecting floors; reject any relative RMS budget above the fixed maximum
confirmation_rule: Freeze all budgets before confirmation; every element must satisfy atol + rtol * abs(expected), every row must satisfy its relative RMS budget, and embeddings must be exact; any failure stops dependent acceptance
